string.name: desktop_agent_preset_standard_description
string.value: Work with code, files, and information. Suitable for most tasks, with search, editing, terminal commands, and other tools available as needed.

string.name: desktop_agent_preset_ptc_description
string.value: Includes all Standard mode capabilities. Better suited to tasks that call tools in batches and then filter, organize, deduplicate, count, or summarize the results.

string.name: desktop_agent_preset_minimal_description
string.value: The agent uses a terminal and image reading, with context compaction. Useful for testing and comparing its basic performance.

string.name: desktop_agent_preset_cordis_description
string.value: Customize DSH through conversation. Let the agent write plugins that add features or UI, or combine tools and prompts to create your own mode.

string.name: desktop_preset_section_intro
string.value: Choose the agent’s tools and how it works. Use Standard mode for everyday tasks, or Creator mode to add capabilities to DSH.
